findings.title: Feature-flagged table visualization renders hardcoded empty data
findings.body: In tableResultComponent, when organization.features includes 'use-table-widget-visualization', TableWidgetVisualization is rendered with columns={[]} and tableData={{data: [], meta: {fields: {}, units: {}}}} instead of the actual result.data, result.meta, and fields. Any dashboard table widget for an organization with this feature enabled will show an empty table and ignore the query results.

findings.title: Error details can be paired with the wrong error ID
findings.body: fetch_error_details builds node_ids from error_ids and then zips error_ids with events.values(). Nodestore get_multi returns a mapping keyed by node id and may omit missing events or not preserve input order; zip pairs by position, so if a replay references an expired/deleted error, subsequent titles/messages/timestamps are attached to the wrong error_id and sent to the summarization endpoint. Use the returned mapping (for example iterate node_ids and look up events.get(node_id)) instead of positional zip.

findings.title: Mutual-exclusivity validation uses truthiness instead of key presence
findings.body: validate_timestamp checks `self.initial_data.get("age")`, and validate_age checks `self.initial_data.get("timestamp")`. age=0 is a valid report age but is falsy, so a report with age=0 and a timestamp is not rejected. Similarly, timestamp=0 with age is not rejected. Presence should be checked with `in self.initial_data` or `is not None`. Also both age and timestamp are currently optional, so reports with neither are accepted; if exactly one is required by the Reporting API specs this endpoint claims to support, add that validation.

findings.title: Analytics event is recorded before feature-flag enforcement
findings.body: analytics.record("preprod_artifact.api.assemble", ...) runs before the `organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble` feature check later in the endpoint. Requests that are not allowed and will return 404 are still counted as preprod artifact assemble events, inflating analytics and reporting usage from disabled organizations. Move the record call after the feature check or record a separate denied event.
